headline: Van Gerwen beats Humphries in decider for Nordic Darts Masters
standfirst: Michael van Gerwen won the World Series event in Copenhagen, edging Luke Humphries 8-7 in a final where only 0.07 separated their averages.
body: Michael van Gerwen won the Nordic Darts Masters at the Forum in Copenhagen, beating Luke Humphries 8-7 in a final that could hardly have been closer. Van Gerwen averaged 98.90 and Humphries 98.83.

Van Gerwen had to work hard early on. He beat Oskar Lukasiak 6-2 and then edged Sweden's Viktor Tingstrom 6-5 in the quarter-finals. He raised his level in the semi-finals, averaging 101.55 to beat Jonny Clayton 7-4.

Humphries was the standout player of the tournament until the final. He averaged 109.92 against Jeffrey De Graaf in the last 16, the best of the event. He then beat Gian van Veen 6-5 and Luke Littler 7-5 in the semi-finals, averaging 105.42 against the world champion and hitting a 164 checkout.
Gian van Veen's 167 checkout against Daniel Larsson was the highest finish of the event. Humphries hit the most maximums with 17, followed by Littler with 13 and Van Gerwen with nine.
